tokens.name: bc-backdrop
tokens.usage: Mobile backdrop behind the device frame. Never a working surface.

tokens.name: bc-canvas
tokens.usage: App canvas: the window behind the shell panels, the main column, and the sticky strip behind the composer. Mobile screen background.

tokens.name: bc-surface
tokens.usage: Panels: sidebar, Favorites/Models panel, mobile starter cards and tab bar.

tokens.name: bc-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards inside a panel, the user's message bubble, nav hover and the active nav item, secondary mobile action card.

tokens.name: bc-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers: sidebar header/footer rules, top bar rule, section-header underline, nav-children guide line, chip borders.

tokens.name: bc-edge
tokens.usage: Outer 1px border of panels (sidebar, Favorites panel, mobile tab bar, starter cards).

tokens.name: bc-edge-soft
tokens.usage: 1px border of cards sitting on a panel (prompt cards, mobile secondary action card).

tokens.name: bc-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bc-canvas, bc-surface, bc-surface-raised and bc-steel-blue-tint (≥9.7:1).

tokens.name: bc-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: nav items at rest, section labels, crumbs, counts, inactive icons. On bc-canvas 6.2:1, bc-surface 5.4:1, bc-surface-raised 4.5:1; on bc-steel-blue-tint 4.3:1 — keep muted text off tinted fills.

tokens.name: bc-placeholder-text
tokens.usage: Hints on the dark surfaces only. 4.0:1 on bc-canvas, 3.5:1 on bc-surface — below 4.5:1 as the source ships it; use for placeholder text, never for content.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue
tokens.usage: Brand fill: send button when armed, primary mobile action card, stage-progress bars, hover border of chips. As text it is too dark on graphite (3.5:1) — use bc-steel-blue-text.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-text
tokens.usage: Brand as text and icon: eyebrows, card categories, tag text, active nav child, assistant label, links, filled stars, focus ring. On bc-canvas 6.8:1, bc-surface 5.9:1, bc-surface-raised 5.0:1, bc-steel-blue-tint 4.7:1.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of a bc-steel-blue control (send button, mobile primary card).

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind bc-steel-blue-text: tags, avatar tile, active nav child, active mobile tab.

tokens.name: bc-steel-blue-edge
tokens.usage: Hover border of prompt cards.

tokens.name: bc-on-steel-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a bc-steel-blue fill. 4.1:1 — the source's pair: fine for icons and the 28px card title, not for small body text.

tokens.name: bc-on-steel-blue-line
tokens.usage: Icon-tile outline on the primary (steel blue) mobile action card.

tokens.name: bc-on-steel-blue-fill
tokens.usage: Arrow disc on the primary (steel blue) mobile action card.

tokens.name: bc-scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, shown only while the scroll area is hovered.

tokens.name: bc-field
tokens.usage: The light input island: composer and quick search. The one light surface in the app — it marks where you type.

tokens.name: bc-field-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover ground of a ghost button inside bc-field (Project picker).

tokens.name: bc-field-ink
tokens.usage: Typed text and icons inside bc-field (14.7:1).

tokens.name: bc-field-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and toolbar icons inside bc-field (5.9:1).

tokens.name: bc-field-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside bc-field (4.7:1).

tokens.name: bc-field-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders inside bc-field (attach button) and the disarmed desktop send button.

tokens.name: bc-field-edge
tokens.usage: Outer 1px border of the composer.

tokens.name: bc-field-edge-soft
tokens.usage: Outer 1px border of the quick-search field.

tokens.name: bc-field-focus
tokens.usage: Composer border while its textarea has focus.

tokens.name: bc-field-steel-text
tokens.usage: Brand text inside bc-field (5.9:1).

tokens.name: bc-field-send-off
tokens.usage: Disarmed send button in both composers (desktop and mobile), with a bc-field-muted arrow.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Overpass ExtraBold, uppercase, tight leading. Headlines only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Desktop hero headline (clamps 28–40px with viewport height). Uppercase.

styles.name: title-mobile
styles.usage: Mobile starter-card text and project names.
styles.sample: Size a VFD and motor for a conveyor drive

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Chat messages and the desktop composer.
styles.sample: Tell us the throughput target, the product and the space available.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav children, card labels, chip buttons, search input.
styles.sample: Run a tolerance stack-up on a bracket assembly

groups.name: Caps
groups.note: Overpass, uppercase, tracked. Brand and button labels.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: App name in the sidebar header (14px on mobile). Uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Header ghost-button labels; mobile tab labels use 12px/600. Uppercase.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Overpass Mono, uppercase, wide tracking. Labels, codes, metadata — never sentences.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above a headline, in bc-steel-blue-text (13px on mobile). Uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, nav group labels, breadcrumbs, message author. Uppercase.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags, counts, card categories (500 weight for categories). Uppercase.

styles.name: code-mobile
styles.usage: Project numbers and stage on mobile rows.
